findings.title: Stable Channel Update for Desktop
findings.summary_md: The vendor advisory, posted Tuesday, September 22, 2026 (page shows the date only), promotes Chrome 154.0.8037.57 on Linux and 154.0.8037.57/.58 on Windows and Mac with 108 security fixes, 11 of them Critical. It carries the researcher record for the story's tracked CVEs: $5,000 for CVE-2026-95350, a buffer overflow in ANGLE reported 2026-08-24 by Billy Jheng Bing Jhong, Muhammad Alifa Ramdhan and Pan Zhenpeng of STAR Labs SG; $2,500 for CVE-2026-95357, an out-of-bounds write in GPU reported 2026-07-01; and CVE-2026-95281, a second ANGLE buffer overflow reported by Muhammad Alifa Ramdhan of STAR Labs SG on 2026-08-24 with the reward still TBD. Google notes bug details stay restricted until a majority of users are updated and makes no exploitation-in-the-wild claim; two high-severity V8 bugs (CVE-2026-95304 out-of-bounds write, CVE-2026-95306 type confusion) are credited to OpenAI Codex Security researcher amyb, reported 2026-09-12.

findings.title: Chrome for Android Update
findings.summary_md: A same-day vendor post, dated Tuesday, September 22, 2026, announcing Chrome 154.0.8037.57 for Android rolling out over the next few days. It states that Android releases contain the same security fixes as the corresponding desktop release unless otherwise noted and links directly to the desktop stable channel advisory, so the 108-fix patch set extended to Android the day before this story was first seen.
